item.title: Tecno Unveils Zero‑Millimeter Border, Bezel‑Less Phone
item.description: At IFA 2026, Tecno unveils a concept phone with a 0‑mm bezel, delivering 100% screen coverage and a fresh design language for its next‑gen devices.
